data.description:
## Observation
On 2026-11-04 PST, at least 4 Verified runs for open changes (3305 run 41857357120; 3307 runs 41855161578 and 41856506741; one more at 41857377497) received Verified -1 although every test that ran passed. In each, the only unsuccessful job was build-and-test / pytest (macos-latest, py3.13), CANCELLED after 15-19 min with the GitHub annotation 'The job was not acquired by Runner of type hosted even after multiple attempts' and a macOS arm64 capacity notice. No step executed and no test ran on that job. The CI bot's own message already labels it 'CANCELLED (not a test verdict)', yet the vote is -1, so each change needs a manual recheck comment (AGENTS.md permits recheck only for provably environmental faults) and re-queues a full run.

## Why it matters
A runner-capacity outage on one platform blocks every change from landing and forces agents to diagnose and justify rechecks by hand. The vote reports a verdict about the change when no verdict exists.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] A job cancelled because no runner was acquired (no steps executed) does not produce Verified -1 as if tests failed; the chosen behaviour (automatic re-queue of that job, a distinct non-verdict outcome, or another mechanism consistent with ADR 0114 on gating CI) is decided and recorded on this ticket.
- [ ] A test reproduces the classification from a captured jobs-API payload for a not-acquired cancellation and for a genuine cancellation mid-test, and asserts they are treated differently.
- [ ] A genuine macOS test failure still produces Verified -1.
data.title: Verified -1 when GitHub never assigns the macOS runner
